newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary shares close flat, BUX index slightly up.
newsitem.headline: Hungary shares close flat, BUX index slightly up.

text.p: Hungarian shares moved sideways and closed mixed on Friday, with the BUX index rising on slight gains posted by heavy-weight stocks, traders said.
"Up a little, down a little, the market does not make headway," said Geza Raner of Bank-Austria Investment.
The BUX index closed at 5,804.05 points, up 15.01 points or 0.26 percent. Spot share turnover totalled 2.4 billion forints, up from 2.07 billion forints on Thursday.
The stocks on the Budapest Stock Exchange closed mixed, with 19 of the issues traded on Friday rising and 12 dropping.
The index was helped to firm by slight gains of two heavy-weight stocks, oil and gas company MOL and chemicals producer TVK.
Both shares rose five forints in high turnover, MOL to 3,220 forints and TVK to 2,720 forints.
Plastic producer Pannonplast, which reported results for the first quarter of the year Thursday night, surprised traders by dropping 100 forints to 8,700.
"(Pannonplast's) results can be said good," said Peter Lencs of MKB Securities. "But this was not reflected in the price."
Raner said Pannonplast rose much in the past few weeks on expectations of good results, and a downward correction in the price may have started on Friday.
Traders said the market was waiting for the first quarter results of other companies to show directions.
"The market is likely to be determined by (the results)," Lencs said.
The earnings reports will be published by the middle of May.
Dealers said they expected good results. The figures may propel shares, although the expectations have partly been built in prices already, they added.
BUX index futures rose by 40.50 to 78 points. The December maturity firmed 78 points to 7,238, while index futures for December 1998 rose to 8,072.5 points, up 42.50.
